arxiv-2109-06133.title: Neuro-Symbolic AI: An Emerging Class of AI Workloads and their Characterization
arxiv-2109-06133.creator: Zachary Susskind, Bryce Arden, Lizy K. John, Patrick Stockton, Eugene B. John
arxiv-2109-06133.description: Abstract Neuro-symbolic artificial intelligence is a novel area of AI research which seeks to combine traditional rules-based AI approaches with modern deep learning techniques. Neuro-symbolic models have already demonstrated the capability to outperform state-of-the-art deep learning models in domains such as image and video reasoning.

arxiv-2203-01739.title: Indefinite q q -integrals from a method using q q -Ricatti equations
arxiv-2203-01739.creator: G. E. Heragy a , Z. S.I. Mansour, b and K. M. Oraby a
arxiv-2203-01739.description: Abstract Earlier work introduced a method for obtaining indefinite q q -integrals of q q -special functions from the second-order linear q q -difference equations that define them. In this paper, we reformulate the method in terms of q q -Riccati equations, which are nonlinear and first order.

arxiv-2205-05768.title: Response to ‘Comment on Theory of growth of number entropy in disordered systems’
arxiv-2205-05768.creator: Roopayan Ghosh, Marko Žnidarič
arxiv-2205-05768.description: Abstract In a recent preprint by Kiefer-Emmanouilidis, Unanyan, Fleischhauer and Sirker [arxiv:2203.06689] the authors comment on our work Ghosh and Žnidarič 2021 which studied the number entropy in strongly disordered systems. The data presented in the comment does not refute what we have stated in our work.

arxiv-2301-12974.title: Improving the Inference of Topic Models via Infinite Latent State Replications
arxiv-2301-12974.creator: Daniel Rugeles, Zhen Hai, Juan Felipe Carmona Manoranjan Dash, Gao Cong
arxiv-2301-12974.description: Abstract In text mining, topic models are a type of probabilistic generative models for inferring latent semantic topics from text corpus. One of the most popular inference approaches to topic models is perhaps collapsed Gibbs sampling (CGS), which typically samples one single topic label for each observed document-word pair.

arxiv-2306-07795.description: Abstract . Optimal usage of the memory system is a key element of fast GPU algorithms. Unfortunately many common algorithms fail in this regard despite exhibiting great regularity in memory access patterns. In this paper we propose efficient kernels to permute the elements of an array.

arxiv-2504-02190.title: A PTAS for Travelling Salesman Problem with Neighbourhoods Over Parallel Line Segments of Similar Length
arxiv-2504-02190.creator: Benyamin Ghaseminia, Mohammad R. Salavatipour
arxiv-2504-02190.description: Abstract We consider the Travelling Salesman Problem with Neighbourhoods (TSPN) on the Euclidean plane ( ℝ 2 \mathbb{R}^{2} ) and present a Polynomial-Time Approximation Scheme (PTAS) when the neighbourhoods are parallel line segments with lengths between [ 1 , λ ] [1,\lambda] for any constant value λ ≥ 1 \lambda\geq 1 .

arxiv-2507-11553.title: Stochastic Dynamics of Ripple XRP for Cross-Border Settlement Optimization
arxiv-2507-11553.creator: Kiarash Firouzi
arxiv-2507-11553.description: Abstract The feasibility of XRP as a liquidity medium in cross-border transactions is assessed in this paper using a thorough stochastic framework. We use simulations of settlement latency, regime-switching volatility, and jump-diffusion models. The models are calibrated using historical data from public exchanges and RippleNet corridors, and they assess FX dynamics, liquidity depth, and tail risks in real-world scenarios.

pmc-10538041.title: Genetic Insights into Intestinal Microbiota and Risk of Infertility: A Mendelian Randomization Study
pmc-10538041.creator: Fuxun Zhang, Yang Xiong, Kan Wu, Linmeng Wang, Yunhua Ji, Bo Zhang, Fabio Pace
pmc-10538041.description: Background: The interaction between intestinal microbiota and infertility is less researched. This study was performed to investigate the causal association between gut microbiota and infertility. Methods: In this two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) study, genetic variants of intestinal microbiota were obtained from the MiBioGen consortium, which included 18,340 individuals.

pmc-10675029.title: A New Assistance Navigation Method for Substation Inspection Robots to Safely Cross Grass Areas
pmc-10675029.creator: Qiang Yang, Song Ma, Gexiang Zhang, Kaiyi Xian, Lijia Zhang, Zhongyu Dai, Qiang Zhang, Yifeng Zeng
pmc-10675029.description: With the development of intelligent substations, inspection robots are widely used to ensure the safe and stable operation of substations. Due to the prevalence of grass around the substation in the external environment, the inspection robot will be affected by grass when performing the inspection task, which can easily lead to the interruption of the inspection task.

pmc-11402194.title: Prevalence of dental carries among school-going children aged 7–13 years in Kabul City
pmc-11402194.creator: Ahmad Khalid Aalemi, Bentulhuda Yaqubi
pmc-11402194.description: BackgroundDental caries is a major, multifactorial oral condition that causes the demineralization of tooth enamel and impacts approximately half of the world’s child population. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of dental caries among school-going children aged 7 to 13 years in Kabul city.

pmc-11416465.title: Intramedullary cervical spinal cord tuberculoma: A rare cause of paraparesis
pmc-11416465.creator: Fadoua Ijim, Mehdi El Kourchi, Soukaina Wakrim
pmc-11416465.description: Neurological manifestations of tuberculosis remain rare, even if recent years have been marked by an increase in these pathologies, notably due to the HIV pandemic. Intramedullary tuberculoma remains an exceptional localization. Magnetic resonance imaging in diagnosing intramedullary tuberculoma and specific medical treatment are of great interest.

pmc-11437507.title: RNAi-Induced Gene Silencing against Chikungunya and COVID-19: What Have We Learned So Far, and What Is the Way Forward?
pmc-11437507.creator: Kingshuk Panda, Kalichamy Alagarasu, Rajarshee Tagore, Mandar Paingankar, Satyendra Kumar, Manish Kumar Jeengar, Sarah Cherian, Deepti Parashar
pmc-11437507.description: RNA interference (RNAi) is a process in which small RNA molecules (such as small interfering RNAs or siRNAs) bind to specific messenger RNAs (mRNAs), leading to its degradation and inhibition of protein synthesis. Our studies have shown that RNAi can effectively silence genes involved in the replication of the Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in cells.

pmc-11666824.title: Anti‐Inflammatory Action and Molecular Mechanism of Fucoidan Against Cystitis Glandularis
pmc-11666824.creator: Qingting Chen, Jie Mo, Yu Li, Li Gao, Ka Wu
pmc-11666824.description: Cystitis glandularis (CG), known as a pre‐gradual lesion in the bladder, is the pathological changes in the vesical mucosa characterized by inflammatory invasion and chronic obstruction. Clinically, effective treatment against CG is prescribed only when using drug therapy. Fucoidan, the naturally extractive polysaccharide, is well‐reported bioactive compound with anti‐inflammatory and immunoregulatory properties.

pmc-11692261.title: ACTIVE IMMUNIZATION AGAINST MYOSTATIN AND ACTIVIN A IMPROVES SKELETAL MUSCLE STRENGTH DESPITE GH/IGF-1 DEFICIENCY
pmc-11692261.creator: Mishfak Abdullah Mohamed Mansoor, Sarah Ashiqueali, Md Tanjim Alam, Amanda Lasseter, Brett Thibodeaux, Michal Masternak
pmc-11692261.description: Muscle wasting is a significant hurdle in patients due to immobilization, prolonged bed rest, and injury. In particular, the older population develops sarcopenia, characterized by progressive loss of muscle strength due to natural aging. However, there are no FDA-approved drugs for sarcopenia, and it is critical to explore novel therapeutics.

pmc-11741121.title: Modulation of Long Non-coding RNA FAS-AS1/FAS/Caspase3 Axis in Endometriosis: A Cross-sectional Study
pmc-11741121.creator: Amir Hossein Shayanfard, Zivar Salehi, Farhad Mashayekhi, Ziba Zahiri
pmc-11741121.description: Background:An increasing number of studies have demonstrated that excessive proliferation and apoptosis play a pivotal role in the development of endometriosis.Aim:The aim of the study was to evaluate the expression of long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) FAS-AS1, FAS, soluble Fas (sFas) and caspase-3 in patients with different stages of endometriosis.Setting and Design:The design of the study was a cross-sectional study.

pmc-12499948.title: Esketamine in a Patient With Major Depressive Disorder and Polysubstance Use: A Case Report
pmc-12499948.creator: Abdelazim Ali, Nahida Ahmed, Sona Varghese
pmc-12499948.description: Major depressive disorder (MDD) frequently co-occurs with substance use disorders (SUDs), leading to poorer outcomes and limited options. Esketamine is approved for treatment-resistant depression (TRD); its effects on craving and abstinence in SUD are less explored. A 41-year-old man with recurrent MDD (suicidal ideation) and polysubstance use (daily morphine/prescription opioids; intermittent methamphetamine) failed multiple antidepressants and engaged in opioid-seeking behavior.

pmc-12536148.title: A cost-effectiveness comparison between immunotherapy combination regimens and sunitinib for advanced renal cell carcinoma in the USA and China
pmc-12536148.creator: Haojie Ying, Fei Tong, Yidong Zhou, Binzhe Zhou, Kai Qiao, Liandong Chen, Qiaoping Xu
pmc-12536148.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background:Immunotherapy combinations like Pembrolizumab + Axitinib and Nivolumab + Ipilimumab have survival benefits over Sunitinib in advanced renal cell carcinoma (aRCC) first-line treatment. But their cost-effectiveness in the USA and China is unclear.Objectives:To assess the cost-effectiveness of three first-line treatment regimens for untreated aRCC—Nivolumab plus Ipilimumab, Pembrolizumab plus Axitinib, and Sunitinib—from the perspective of national health service systems and indirect healthcare payers in China and the USA, with a focus on intent-to-treat (ITT) populations and International mRCC Database Consortium (IMDC) risk stratifications.Design:Decision-tree

pmc-13357911.title: Stable mercury isotopes as a decision-support tool for public health
pmc-13357911.creator: Arioene Vreedzaam, Firoz Abdoel Wahid, Maureen Y. Lichtveld, Wilco Zijlmans, Jeffrey Wickliffe
pmc-13357911.description: Widespread mercury exposure remains a critical global health challenge, particularly in regions affected by artisanal and small-scale gold mining (ASGM). Conventional biomonitoring documents “body burden,” it often fails to pinpoint specific environmental sources, hindering targeted public health interventions. This viewpoint article proposes reframing mercury stable isotope analysis as a decision-support tool within existing public health workflows.
